primary_metric: number of build scenarios with at least one native-success and one native-failure episode whose recorded prefixes replay identically
falsification: Zero mixed-outcome scenarios or unverified replay rejects this source protocol as sufficient input to outcome-contrast induction; do not invent a learned bank
selection_note: Hash-order native train scenario groups after excluding the full oracle fixture group; lowest numeric variant per group. Reserve dev/audit/evaluation groups without running or inspecting their instructions. Evaluation here is train-derived development holdout, not official final test.
interpretation: Source collection only, no CoProCon efficacy comparison. Normal tool-error correction is allowed. Final task failure is not a causal label for each handoff. All outcomes and ineligible prefixes remain in the denominator.
